notes.title: Absent Mind Framerate
notes.content: Hello everyone. I would like to apologize for the recent issues with framerate. I am currently working on an update to fix this and I will also be adding something to tell you the controls. Thank you for your feedback with this issues and have a wonderful day!

notes.title: Absent Mind Has Been Released!
notes.content: I am very happy to say that Absent Mind has just been released on the Steam store. I would like to thank everyone who helped get this game on Steam, whether it was by voting for it through Steam Greenlight, or just by giving me moral support. I can't wait to make more games in the future, but until then please enjoy my latest release, Absent Mind.
